messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for high 503 rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (alert: svc_high_5xx_rate). See runbook: https://internal.runbooks/5xx-triage
Alex Chen: saw the page, taking lead. currently under 2x baseline but spiking. pulling logs now.
Priya Nair: thx alex — i'm on secondary. i'll start checking autoscaler + recent deploys. any customer-facing impact yet?
Alex Chen: not seeing mass errors in Sentry, but a few B2B customers reported degraded latency and timeouts. Erin, any support tickets?
Erin Park: a couple of support threads flagged 504s to large customers doing batch embeddings. emailed CSMs to acknowledge incident. no public status page update yet.
Samir Patel: quick glance at runtime metrics — KV cache miss rate jumped ~4x right when spike started. suspect cache invalidation after node restart.
Priya Nair: can you dump the recent kube events and pod restart list?
Samir Patel: posted snippet:```
kubectl -n inference get events --last=2h
NAME           TYPE      REASON    AGE   FROM               MESSAGE
pod/serve-xyz  Warning   BackOff   1h    kubelet            Back-off restarting failed container
```
Alex Chen: interesting — some worker pods restarted ~1h ago. could be rolling deploy or node OOM. Jordan, do we have a scheduled deploy that matches that window?
Jordan Lee: no user-facing deploys in that window. infra autoscaler did evict a few pods during a noisy neighbor event on host-gpu-12. tracking.
Priya Nair: mitigation plan: 1) scale up swarm by +2 nodes (temporary) 2) pin affected customers to fallback variant (lower memory) 3) enable prefix-cache warmup for hot keys 4) monitor 5xx rate and latency. Alex, can you run the scaling?
Alex Chen: scaling now: `autoscaler scale --pool inference-prod --add-nodes 2`
incident-bot: autoscaler: scaling request accepted, provisioning 2 nodes (ETA ~4m).
Samir Patel: while nodes come up, i pushed a quick config to pin heavy embeddings customers to quantized model variant:```
route: /v1/generate
policy: fallback_to_quantized_for_batch_embeddings: true
```
Erin Park: update to CSMs: "We've identified a worker eviction that caused cache churn and transient 5xxs. We're scaling and applying mitigations; we'll follow up with postmortem and customer impact summary."
Alex Chen: after scale, 503 rate dropped to near baseline, latency improving. still keep monitoring for 15m.
Priya Nair: confirming — error rate trending down. good containment.
Jordan Lee: note for postmortem: root cause likely noisy neighbor + insufficient pod disruption budget for the worker pool. also autoscaler provisioning delay exacerbated impact.
Samir Patel: action item (short): adjust podDisruptionBudget for serve-workers to minAvailable=3 -> owner: Samir, due: 2026-04-02
Priya Nair: action item (infra): add a node warm pool for gpu instances in us-west-2 to reduce autoscaler latency -> owner: Jordan, due: 2026-04-09
Erin Park: action item (cust comms): prepare templated customer update for affected accounts and a post-incident summary for CSMs -> owner: Erin, due: 2026-03-30
Alex Chen: scheduling postmortem session. propose 2026-03-31 16:00 PT (one hour). who can join?
Priya Nair: i'll be there.
Samir Patel: add me.
Jordan Lee: in calendar.
Maya Ortiz: PM + product impact attendee, i'll join and can help synthesize customer impact.
Alex Chen: created doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2018364920-serve-worker-eviction — please add logs, timelines, diffs.
Priya Nair: for postmortem prep: collect timeline (alert -> mitigation), list of deploys/events, autoscaler logs, node eviction traces, and affected customer list. Samir will attach runtime profile and cache metrics.
Samir Patel: attaching sample queries and heatmap snapshots in doc (will be there before meeting).
Alex Chen: during postmortem we'll allocate owners for remediation tasks and decide which items go straight to sprint. also planning an org-wide brown-bag to share prevention patterns.
Maya Ortiz: brown-bag suggestion: focus on "Serving reliability patterns: pod churn, cache hygiene, and fallback policies". 30-45 mins, internal audience (eng + platform + support). propose week of 2026-04-13.
Priya Nair: agree, this is a good teachable event. i'd cover runbook improvements and incident triage checklist.
Jordan Lee: i'll cover autoscaler tuning & node maintenance best practices.
Samir Patel: i'll demo cache warmup and KV metrics to watch.
Erin Park: i'll present customer comms templates and timing for post-incident updates.
Alex Chen: creating action tracker in the doc — please use short IDs: A1, A2 etc.
Alex Chen: A1 - adjust podDisruptionBudget for serve-workers -> Samir -> due 2026-04-02
Alex Chen: A2 - provision node warm pool in us-west-2 -> Jordan -> due 2026-04-09
Alex Chen: A3 - craft and send templated customer updates -> Erin -> due 2026-03-30
Alex Chen: A4 - add autoscaler alert for provisioning lag > 3m -> Priya -> due 2026-04-05
Priya Nair: A5 - improve runbook step for cache invalidation recovery (include warmup script) -> Priya -> due 2026-04-06
Samir Patel: A6 - add synthetic test harness for KV cache misses in staging -> Samir -> due 2026-04-12
Maya Ortiz: A7 - organize brown-bag and create invite + recording link -> Maya -> due 2026-04-10
Erin Park: noted, starting draft for A3 now. will circulate by EOD.
Alex Chen: quick note on severity classification for postmortem: classify as sev3 (partial customer impact to specific accounts, contained <2h). we should validate with support metrics in doc.
Jordan Lee: agree sev3. include mitigation timeline and decision rationale in the postmortem.
Priya Nair: please all update the doc with evidence before the meeting — we want a crisp 20-min timeline + 10-min actions in the 1h slot.
Samir Patel: uploaded flamegraphs and cache hit-rate series.
Alex Chen: after meeting we'll publish a short summary to #general and link to the doc and brown-bag invite. Erin, you'll coordinate the customer-facing follow-up thread?
Erin Park: yes — I'll draft the thread and get approvals from legal/PM as needed.
incident-bot: Incident updated — status: contained, severity: sev3, incident_owner: Alex Chen. postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-31 16:00 PT.
Alex Chen: thanks team. retrospective + action follow-through is priority. I'll do a handoff note to next oncall at shift change. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: thanks all, great work containing this quickly.
Maya Ortiz: thanks team — good learning opportunity. I'll reserve the brown-bag slot and put together slides.
Jordan Lee: closing loop: i'll validate node eviction evidence and post results in the doc by EOD tomorrow.
Samir Patel: will verify cache warmup script in staging and report back.
Erin Park: sending customer acknowledgment now.
Alex Chen: handing off to night oncall — @Priya, you'll be secondary tonight?
Priya Nair: yep, i'll be reachable.
Alex Chen: handing over. thread closed for primary ops; will reopen for postmortem notes.
